name: naksha-doctor-transcripts-misroute
prompt: /naksha-doctor --transcripts (the scanned transcripts hold two naksha runs: one session asked 'Design a welcome email for new signups' and only ui-designer.md was read; another asked for a landing page, named the Motion Designer in the team, and produced no motion spec)
expected_output: Runs the local transcript scanner, flags the email task as misrouted and the Motion Designer as a silent role, and writes generalized regression evals to .naksha/proposed-evals.json without touching evals/evals.json

assertions.name: runs-local-scanner
assertions.description: Runs scripts/scan-transcripts.js locally and reports its file, line and unparseable counts

assertions.name: flags-email-misroute
assertions.description: Flags the welcome-email session as M1 Misrouted because the Email Designer and Email Copywriter never activated

assertions.name: flags-silent-motion
assertions.description: Flags the Motion Designer as an M2 Silent role because no durations, easing or transitions were produced

assertions.name: evals-without-id
assertions.description: Each proposed eval has name, prompt, expected_output and 4-6 assertions, and no id field

assertions.name: writes-proposed-file-only
assertions.description: Writes .naksha/proposed-evals.json and states that evals/evals.json was not edited

assertions.name: states-local-only
assertions.description: States that transcript content stayed on this machine and quotes no more than a short phrase of any task

name: naksha-doctor-transcripts-missing-evidence
prompt: /naksha-doctor --transcripts (a past /design-review run activated the UI Designer and UX Researcher; the reply has no contrast ratios, no severity ratings and no screenshots at any width)
expected_output: Compares the activated roles' Evidence of done items against the output, flags M3 Missing evidence for both roles, and proposes evals whose assertions are the missing evidence items

assertions.name: loads-contracts
assertions.description: Loads Quality Contracts with scripts/check-role-contracts.js --json (or by reading the role references)

assertions.name: flags-ui-evidence
assertions.description: Flags the UI Designer for missing contrast ratios and missing 375/768/1440 previews

assertions.name: flags-researcher-evidence
assertions.description: Flags the UX Researcher for missing severity ratings in a findings table

assertions.name: evidence-as-assertions
assertions.description: Proposed eval assertions are written from the missing Evidence of done items, not generic checks

assertions.name: generalized-prompt
assertions.description: The proposed eval prompt is a rewritten, anonymized version of the task, not a verbatim copy

name: naksha-doctor-transcripts-none-found
expected_output: Reports that no transcripts were found at the path it checked, asks for a valid path, and writes nothing

assertions.name: reports-path-checked
assertions.description: Names the path it looked in

assertions.name: asks-for-path
assertions.description: Asks the user for a transcript file or folder

assertions.name: no-file-written
assertions.description: Does not create or modify .naksha/proposed-evals.json

assertions.name: no-health-checks
assertions.description: Does not run the Step 2 health checks in transcript mode

name: naksha-doctor-role-contract-fix
prompt: /naksha-doctor --fix (skills/design/references/print-designer.md has a Quality Contract with no Evidence of done subsection)
expected_output: Reports validate-structure failing on role-quality-contracts and gives step-by-step remediation for adding the missing subsection

assertions.name: names-failing-check
assertions.description: Reports the role-quality-contracts check as failed, with print-designer.md named

assertions.name: check-count
assertions.description: Shows validate-structure as 8/9 checks passed

assertions.name: fix-steps
assertions.description: Remediation says to add '### Evidence of done' with 3-5 checkable items specific to print work

assertions.name: points-to-checker
assertions.description: Points to node scripts/check-role-contracts.js to see the full list of problems

name: quality-contract-evidence-landing-page
prompt: Build a pricing page for a SaaS analytics tool with three tiers and a monthly/annual toggle
expected_output: A responsive pricing page whose delivery notes include the UI Designer's evidence of done: contrast ratios, previews at three widths, component states and a token map

assertions.name: contrast-ratios-listed
assertions.description: Lists measured contrast ratios for the text/background pairs used, each at least 4.5:1 for body text

assertions.name: three-breakpoints
assertions.description: Shows or describes the layout at 375, 768 and 1440px

assertions.name: toggle-states
assertions.description: Specifies hover, focus, active and disabled states for the billing toggle and CTA buttons

assertions.name: single-primary-cta
assertions.description: Each tier card has exactly one primary-styled CTA

assertions.name: token-map
assertions.description: Colors and spacing used are traced to named tokens rather than hardcoded values
